title: CLAUDE.md — mocaredd.dev2
text: Active app path (v2) — wired R/shiny_run_mocaredd_dev2.R: UI/server modules: mod_home_UI2 / mod_home_server2, mod_tool_UI2 / mod_tool_server2, mod_about_*. Shared state: one rv reactiveValues list (checks, inputs, sims, res, gt, histo, actions) passed modules. rv$checked holds full fct_checkinput() output. inst/assets served assets/ via .onLoad() R/zzz.R. Calculation chain (used mod_tool_server2): fct_checkinput() reads validates xlsx, detects template_version (1 2), returns $data setup, time, area, carbon. Every downstream function takes .checked_data. fct_arithmetic_mean2(): deterministic means IPCC Approach 1 propagation. fct_arithmetic_mean3(): outputs, step--step IPCC Approach 1 (product/sum rules fct_make_formula2() terms, (1 + RS) resolved first, (1 - DG_ratio) * C_intact intact→degraded EF). Assumes independent terms, ER uncertainty higher MC REF MON share EFs. yet wired app. fct_combine_mcs_E(): simulates CF, carbon elements, AD; builds C stocks (incl. DG_ratio), EF = C_i − C_f, E = AD × EF per transition simulation. fct_combine_mcs_P(): aggregates periods (reference / monitoring). fct_combine_mcs_ER(): emission reductions. fct_calc_res(), fct_forestplot(), fct_histogram(), fct_round(): results outputs. Helpers: fct_make_mcs() (PDF draws), fct_make_formula2() (carbon stock formula, biomass factored: AGB * (1 + RS) * CF; fct_make_formula() kept comparison), fct_make_formula_U() (matching se formula, IPCC Approach 1 product/sum rules, evaluated <el> <el>_se), fct_make_EF(). Legacy v1 (wired app; keep replacement confirmed, don’t extend): mod_home_UI, mod_home_server, mod_tool_UI, mod_tool_server, fct_check_data2, fct_arithmetic_mean, fct_sensitivity (unexported). Function conventions: fct_* functions, mod_* modules, arguments prefixed dot (.checked_data, .n_iter), native pipe |>, .data$col inside dplyr, rlang::.data imported.

title: CLAUDE.md — mocaredd.dev2
text: Emissions per transition: E = AD × EF. ERR = FREL (reference period mean) − monitoring emissions. Periods weighted length (1/n_REF vs 1/n_MON), monitoring-period transitions carry weight per unit area uncertainty. Standards: IPCC Approach 1 (error propagation formulas) vs Approach 2 (Monte Carlo). FCPF Carbon Fund ART-TREES require Monte Carlo — app must keep path robust. Carbon: pools (AGB, BGB via RS, deadwood, litter, soil), CF stocks dry matter, DG_ratio degraded classes relative intact class (lu_intact_*, c_intact_*).

title: CLAUDE.md — mocaredd.dev2
text: big <- fct_combine_mcs_E(checked) gives realised AD EF per transition × simulation (plus period_type, period_length). script pivots bank (n_sim × 2·NT) evaluates ERR = Σ_t wt_t · AD_t · EF_t, wt_t = (+1/n_REF REF, −1/n_MON MON*, 0 untyped gap periods) / period_length. n_REF, n_MON numbers periods, years. Monitoring transitions carry weight fewer MON periods.

title: CLAUDE.md — mocaredd.dev2
text: EF kept whole shared carbon draws: split activity/period, groups correlate ~0.99 split identifiable. Independence tested, assumed: 5×5 correlation group drivers (row means), typically max |rho| ≈ 0.02; flagged ≥ 0.15. independent groups, Shapley effects exact additive (sum 100 %). share AD × EF interaction variance (ERR bilinear), dependence. Estimator: sensitivity::shapleyPermEx(), group one “input” via bank-row index, group frozen/resampled block. Nv = n_sim. Cost Nv + d!(d−1)··Ni. Experimental check: sobolshap_knn() group subsets, Shapley assembled permutations. Biased low high-dimensional EF; shares usually don’t sum 1. Expected UGA: AD ≈ 0.92, EF ≈ 0.08; DF ≈ 0.91, DG ≈ 0.07, shared EF ≈ 0.02.

title: CLAUDE.md — mocaredd.dev2
text: AD source (area sheet: trans_area, trans_se) swung across mean ± z·SE, z = qnorm(1 − (1 − conf_level)/2) (0.9 → 1.645), else baseline. ERR linear AD, swing_t = wt_t · EF_bar_t · 2z·SE_t, EF_bar_t simulated mean EF (baseline ). AD, squared swing ranking = normalised first-order Sobol’ = SensIt “Percent Swing²”; breaks EF/carbon (shared draws).

what: Calculate emissions and IPCC Approach 1 uncertainty from arithmetic means — fct_arithmetic_mean3
title: Calculate emissions and IPCC Approach 1 uncertainty from arithmetic means — fct_arithmetic_mean3
text: Deterministic counterpart Monte Carlo chain (fct_combine_mcs_E(), fct_combine_mcs_P(), fct_combine_mcs_ER()), following steps means instead simulations, propagating uncertainty IPCC Approach 1 rules (IPCC 2006, Vol. 1, Ch. 3, Eq. 3.1 3.2): product: relative standard errors combine quadrature, \(U_{b} = \sqrt{U_a^2 + U_b^2}\); sum / difference: absolute standard errors combine quadrature, \(se_{+ b} = \sqrt{se_a^2 + se_b^2}\). Calculation chain: Carbon stock land use fct_make_formula2(). Composite factors resolved first: (1 + RS) (AGB + BGB). product rule within term, sum rule across terms. Degraded land uses: DG_ratio * C_intact (product rule), plus pools excluded degradation dg_pool "". Emission factors: EF = (C_i - C_f) * 44/12 (sum rule). intact degraded transitions EF = (1 - DG_ratio) * C_intact * 44/12 (product rule), intact stock counted twice. Emissions: E = AD * EF (product rule), annualised fct_combine_mcs_E(). Emissions per time period REDD+ activity (sum rule). Reference monitoring levels: length-weighted mean annual emissions time periods (sum rule). Emission reductions: ER = FREL - E_MON (sum rule). Approach 1 assumes combined terms independent. Correlations shared inputs (carbon fraction, carbon stock used several transitions, emission factors reference monitoring periods) ignored; Monte Carlo simulations (Approach 2) account .

title: Make the carbon stock formula of a land use from its carbon elements — fct_make_formula2
text: Successor fct_make_formula(). inputs, biomass part written input appears : - AGB + RS:  AGB * (1 + RS) (BGB derived AGB), - AGB + BGB: (AGB + BGB), multiplied CF biomass dry matter (DM). DW, LI SOC added separate terms.
code: Both versions give the same carbon stock. The factored form makes          the AGB/BGB dependence explicit, which matters when uncertainty is          propagated term by term with IPCC Approach 1 rules.

what: Make the carbon stock uncertainty formula of a land use (IPCC Approach 1) — fct_make_formula_U
title: Make the carbon stock uncertainty formula of a land use (IPCC Approach 1) — fct_make_formula_U
text: Companion fct_make_formula2(): inputs, returns formula standard error carbon stock, built terms fct_make_formula2() IPCC Approach 1 rules (IPCC 2006, Vol. 1, Ch. 3, Eq. 3.1 3.2): - product: x * y * sqrt((x_se / x)^2 + (y_se / y)^2), - sum: sqrt(x_se^2 + y_se^2).
code: Composite factors are resolved first:          - \code{(1 + RS)}: standard error \code{RS_se},          - \code{(AGB + BGB)}: standard error \code{sqrt(AGB_se^2 + BGB_se^2)}.           Evaluate it with each element and its standard error as          \code{<element>} and \code{<element>_se} (e.g. \code{AGB}, \code{AGB_se},          \code{CF}, \code{CF_se}). Terms are assumed independent. A factor          equal to 0 in a product returns NaN.
